title: Uruguayan-Style Pillowy Rice Bake
description: A flavorful and comforting side dish inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, combining aromatic spices with pillowy rice.
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil.
In a large bowl, combine Uruguayan rice, aromatic spices, and salt. Mix well.
Add pillowy to the rice mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the rice mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the rice is lightly toasted and the pillowy is crispy.
Remove from oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional aromatic spices if desired.
